description: This file is a Java interface for the Journal Entry Read Platform Service within the Fineract accounting module. It declares methods for retrieving journal entries, office opening balances, and related data, used as part of the accounting journal entry management.

classes.name: JournalEntryReadPlatformService
classes.description: Java interface defining methods for retrieving journal entries and related data in the accounting module.

methods.name: retrieveGLJournalEntryById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific general ledger journal entry by its ID, with optional association parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves paginated journal entries based on various search parameters, account ID, date ranges, transaction ID, and entity type.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeOpeningBalances
methods.description: Retrieves office opening balances for a specified office and currency.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesByEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries associated with a specific entity identified by transaction ID and entity ID.
